note: Cincinnati's proposed market-factory census, ported into the canonical contract by PTF-CENSUS-PARTITION-NORMALIZATION-001. Nothing is published. The market spans three states and its committed corridor annotations carry known defects; both are preserved exactly and belong to Phase D.

collision_audit.notes: ADDRESS COLLISION: Hyatt Place Cincinnati Northeast and Candlewood Suites Cincinnati Northeast-Mason both list 5070 Natorp Blvd, Mason OH 45040 in source search results -- both retained IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL pending capture-time address verification (adjacent-building same-plaza addresses are common in this corridor; not assumed to be the same hotel). ADDRESS COLLISION: Comfort Inn & Suites Middletown-Franklin and Rodeway Inn Middletown both list 6575 Terhune Dr, Middletown OH 45044 -- both retained IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL pending verification; may be a shared-building dual-brand property or a transcription artifact from the source search snippet. status: NO_OPEN_CONFLICTS requiring resolution before capture -- both pairs are held provisional, neither is publishable as-is.

source_methodology: First-pass census built from official county/regional visitor-bureau lodging directories (Clermont County discoverclermont.com, Dearborn County IN visitsoutheastindiana.com, Butler County travelbutlercounty.com, Warren County ohioslargestplayground.com -- each fetched directly and its listed hotel names + street addresses transcribed verbatim, marked IDENTITY_CONFIRMED) plus general web/brand-directory search results for corridors with no official CVB directory reachable this run (marked IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL where a name+city+brand match was found without an independently-sourced street address, IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED where only a name was found and address/phone recovery is still required). NO pet-policy fact is asserted anywhere in this file; policy_state is POLICY_NOT_VERIFIED throughout. This is a first-pass census, not a complete one -- Covington/Newport KY, the Grant/Pendleton/Gallatin/Bracken KY tier, downtown Cincinnati, and Blue Ash/Sharonville lack an official-directory pass and stay address-unresolved; see per-corridor _census_note fields in the market registry for what remains.
